guidance: The deliverable is a review of one paper; the sources are that paper's own extracted fulltext, figures, and tables. A claim is verified when the review accurately reflects what the paper says/shows. Flag: findings the paper does not actually make, overstated effect sizes, mis-described figures/tables, and any 'the paper proves X' where the paper only suggests X. If your review templates already include a claims-audit style, this workflow is that audit run as a per-claim fan-out.
note: Layout assumed: one folder per paper, holding its extracted fulltext, figures/, tables/ and a reviews/ folder that receives both the reviews and the audit output. Edit the globs if your workspace differs. Run per paper folder: resolve {folder} to the paper directory, then targets = its reviews/*.md and sources = its fulltext + figures + tables.
